sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT THE OTHER CALLER THOUGHT ABOUT THE LAST FEW MOVIES THEY SAW. WHAT MOVIES HAVE YOU SEEN LATELY?
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hey, how's it going?
ParticipantB: Hey, good. How are you?
ParticipantA: Pretty good. Just teaching again today. It's this high school English stuff, you know? It's interesting, honestly.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I can imagine. I'm at the auto shop mostly. Fixing cars, you know?
ParticipantA: Oh, cool. So, what movies have you seen lately?
ParticipantB: Uh, well, I saw "The Fall Guy" the other day.
ParticipantA: Oh, that one? I heard about it. I actually saw "Kung Fu Panda 4" recently.
ParticipantB: Really? I didn't catch that. What did you think?
ParticipantA: You know, it was... okay? Not great, but fun? Like, the jokes were a little hit or miss.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I felt that. It felt a little too long, maybe?
ParticipantA: Yeah, exactly. And the first act felt like it dragged on forever.
ParticipantB: Oh, really? That's a bummer.
ParticipantA: Yeah. But, I have to say, the fight scenes were pretty slick. You know, like, really well done.
ParticipantB: Oh, I didn't see the fight scenes. My friend Gary went with me. He's the guy who works at the dealership next door.
ParticipantA: Oh, Gary? Hey, that's cool. Did he like it?
ParticipantB: No, he hated it. He said it was a total waste of his time.
ParticipantA: Wow, okay. That's a tough crowd to please.
ParticipantB: Yeah, he said the whole thing felt fake. Like, "why are we paying to watch this?"
ParticipantA: Well, I think that's the thing. It was a fantasy. Sometimes you just want the fantasy, you know?
ParticipantB: Hmm. Well, Gary's pretty hard on movies these days. He's seen some of the new ones coming up.
ParticipantA: Yeah, I know. It can be tricky. I actually saw "Despicable Me 4" yesterday.
ParticipantB: Oh, the Minions?
ParticipantA: Yeah.
ParticipantB: Okay, I actually went with my nephew, so I'm biased.
ParticipantA: Oh, good.
ParticipantB: It was funny though. Very funny. My nephew was laughing the whole time.
ParticipantA: That's good to hear. Sometimes those just hit the spot.
ParticipantB: Yeah, definitely. Simple, you know? Just straight up fun.
ParticipantA: Totally. I think that's what I'll stick with more.
ParticipantB: Fair enough. Hey, did you see that new sci-fi thing?
ParticipantA: Oh, the one with the space stuff? Yeah, I saw that last week.
ParticipantB: Right?
ParticipantA: I thought it was a bit deep, honestly. Maybe too deep?
ParticipantB: Oh, really? What did you think of the story?
ParticipantA: The story was okay, but the characters felt a little flat.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I felt that too. It felt like they didn't care much about the people in it.
ParticipantA: Exactly. That's the thing I tell people sometimes. Like, you need to care about the characters, not just the explosions.
ParticipantB: Yeah, Gary always says that too. He's got a big opinion on that.
ParticipantA: That's true. It's funny, people always think I'm boring because I work in school, but I really care about stories.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I get that. I care about the machines, you know?
ParticipantA: I bet.
ParticipantB: Anyway, glad I called. Thanks for talking.
ParticipantA: Yeah, no problem. Thanks for talking to me.
ParticipantB: Okay, bye.
ParticipantA: Bye.
